amplifications within the egfr gene are associated with the overexpression of eps15 and the caveolin-1 protein in phyllodes tumors.
egfr amplifications are associated with the overexpression of caveolin- 1 and eps15 and that these proteins may play a role in the regulation of the EGFR pathway in phyllodes tumors of the breast.

the amplification of the epidermis growth factor receptor gene is associated with the expression and activation of the epiderm growth factor receptor and the expression of caveolins, eps15 and mdm2, which are important regulators of EGFR turnover and signal transduction, in breast phyllodes tumors.

the identification of novel molecular targets for diagnosis, prognosis and treatment of phyllodes breast cancer.

the identification of the molecular mechanisms involved in the initiation and progression in phyllodes breast tumours, and with the identification of new molecular targets for the development of new therapeutic approaches.
the elucidation of the molecular pathogenesis of phyllodes breast tumours, a rare disease entity, and the identification of molecular markers for the prediction of clinical outcome.
